items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: Russell had the job, so I went over there with him and copied music... we were arranging the music. Russell Wooding.

ctx.x: Earlier than that, maybe because Paul Whiteman was over there in '33.
Well, it was right during that big age. They closed one season and opened another and they had -- Russell had the job, so I went over there with him and copied music. We on.
